title: Analytics Engineer
description: The Analytics Engineering team at DoorDash is embedded within the Analytics and Data Engineering organizations and is responsible for building internal data products that scale decision-making across business teams and drive efficiency in operations. As an Analytics Engineer, the candidate will build and scale data foundations that enable fast, reliable, and actionable insights and work closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Operators. Responsibilities include collaborating with data scientists, data engineers, and business stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data requirements; identifying business questions and generating insights; leading development of data products and self-service tools; building and maintaining canonical datasets using high-volume reliable ETL/ELT pipelines and data lake and data warehousing concepts; designing metrics and visualizations using tools such as Tableau, Sigma, and Mode; and maintaining high data integrity standards. Requirements include 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role; strong SQL; proficiency in Python or Scala; expertise with reporting and visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Sigma; familiarity with database fundamentals including S3, Trino, Hive, and Spark; SQL performance tuning; data quality checks; excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills; and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Nice-to-have experience includes Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, Airflow, Dagster, dbt, and experimentation concepts such as A/B testing.
